record.question: Which Film won the award for the 'best feature film in Hindi' in the 55th National Film Award 2009?
record.explanation: The government's 21 October 2009 report explicitly identifies Amrit Sagar's 1971 as Best Feature Film in Hindi at the 55th National Film Awards for 2007. None of A-C names that film, so D None of these is correct. First-pass Gandhi My Father is wrong; it won different categories. Historical exam context: 2010-03-24 (full date printed on cover). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=53330 Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
